data.name: Santanu Ghosh
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Santanu Ghosh has made a big mark in cricket. With 17 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 40, with an average of 12.06 and a quick strike rate of 113.26. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 7 sixes and 26 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 8.0 overs, taking 1 wickets at an economy rate of 16.00. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
